name: Auto Deco
description: Adds a Deco button to the editor that auto-decorates edges, blocks and hazards.

edge-ids.name: Edge deco IDs
edge-ids.description: Comma-separated object IDs placed along exposed block edges (e.g. 1,2,3).

fill-ids.name: Fill deco IDs
fill-ids.description: Comma-separated object IDs scattered on blocks.

hazard-ids.name: Hazard deco IDs
hazard-ids.description: Comma-separated object IDs placed beside spikes and other hazards.
